A1.justification: Both 18-page PDFs describe the same ArcAD study and support reliable comparison. Pages 2–18 have identical text and rendered content. Neither PDF includes an appendix or the supplementary material referenced in Section 4.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original ArcAD evaluations on four datasets, ablation experiments and qualitative analyses, including Tables 1–6.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the same original benchmark results, ablation experiments and qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain identical prototype modeling, anomaly synthesis, defect-guided calibration, training objectives and reconstruction-based inference.

E1.justification: Both evaluate cold-start anomaly detection and localization on MVTec-AD, VisA, Real-IAD and the tiny version of MANTA, under the same single-class and multi-class scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within each experiment. Tables 1–3 retain their baseline rows, while Tables 5–6 retain the same clustering and anomaly-synthesis alternatives.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 preserves the data construction, 30% normal-training subset, dataset-specific anomaly ratios, evaluation metrics and 10,000 training iterations. Settings for the sensitivity and ablation experiments are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The anomaly-ratio, component, clustering, synthesis and prototype-count analyses are identical, as are the localization and feature visualizations (Tables 3–6 and Figures 5–6).

E5.justification: Both report the same class-averaged point estimates. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports identical multi-class Real-IAD ArcAD scores of 92.5/99.0/49.8 for I-AUROC/P-AUROC/P-F1-max.

T1.justification: The cold-start formalization, hyperspherical and vMF definitions, transport formulation and objective equations (1)–(10) are unchanged. No mathematical derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain identical claims about plug-and-play calibration, normal-boundary modeling and performance under cold-start conditions.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and interpretations of results are identical. Section 5 retains the limitation of additional training cost and the claim of unchanged inference efficiency.

D1.justification: Implementation details, preprocessing descriptions, optimizer settings, loss weights and the code-access link are unchanged. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion, research positioning, in-text citations and all 55 references are identical.

P1.justification: On page 1, affiliation 5 changes Central South University's location from 'Sydney, Australia' to 'Changsha, China'. The arXiv version/date stamp also updates; scientific prose and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Page 1 has a slightly recentered affiliation line and a repositioned marginal arXiv stamp. All six figures, six tables and the rendered layouts of pages 2–18 are identical.

improvement.justification: The affiliation-location update and marginal stamp changes are administrative presentation edits. The scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations and limitations remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
